seo.title: Seialz — Marketing and sales in a single system
seo.description: Seialz connects marketing and sales on the same data, from the first click to revenue. No integrations, no spreadsheets, no noise.

hero.subtitle: Seialz connects marketing and sales data from the first click to revenue. One platform where both teams operate on the same information — no integrations, no spreadsheets, no noise.

problem.titleLead: When marketing and sales run apart,
problem.body: One team tracks cost per lead, the other tracks conversion, and the data rarely lines up. Without a single view it's hard to tell what actually drives results — and decisions start relying more on gut feel than on data.

solution.body: Seialz treats marketing and sales as a single operation. Every lead enters with its source recorded, moves through the pipeline, and has its revenue tied back to the campaign that generated it. The result is a real-time source of truth where marketing and sales see exactly the same information.

loop.body: With marketing and sales on the same data, every closed deal feeds information back into the operation. Marketing learns which campaigns actually drive revenue, attracts better-qualified leads, and the sales team converts more consistently. Every cycle sharpens the operation.

steps.title: Source
steps.description: the lead enters with its originating campaign recorded.

steps.title: Conversion
steps.description: every interaction is tracked up to close.

steps.title: Learning
steps.description: results flow back and guide the next campaigns.
